posts.post_subject: International Symposium on Display Holography, July 06
posts.content_md:
A mailshot was sent out to Hans Bjelkhagen's holography list on Friday with the infor for this exciting conference coming up a year from now, in North Wales. The intention is that this is going to follow the tradition of the infamous Lake Forest conferences. So make plans now, folks, and let's put holography back on the map.

I am involved wth the organization, and I am happy to discuss any points and take any suggestions.

I have uploaded the information files that were sent out here:

[http://homepage.mac.com/kaveh1000/.cv/k ... df-zip.zip](http://homepage.mac.com/kaveh1000/.cv/kaveh1000/Sites/.Public/First_Call_for_Papers.pdf-zip.zip)

posts.content_md: Actually, I intended to do one for the SPIE because Lessard encouraged me for a paper too. However, just a theoretical treatment with a conclusion drawn from a set of equations is not enough. I need to do some experiments in support of the equations and I hadn't got the time. So, the Wales conference gives me a timetable.
